title: 第一百六十八章 扶持第一百六十七章 河东号
content_zh:
河东号沿着远方清晰可见的陆地轮廓缓缓而行，四艘瑞典战船紧跟在两侧。
艳阳高照，碧蓝大海景色极美。
船楼甲板，陆宁伫立栏杆前，在他身旁，战兢兢站着一位年色苍白的金发少年，他脸上雀斑还未褪净，也就是十四五的样子，他便是弗朗齐歇克伯爵和安嘉夫人的独生子——卢比可。
毫无疑问，弗朗齐歇克伯爵夫妇就算不是人中龙凤，也称得上是波兰贵族中的佼佼者，但显然对儿子很是溺爱，使得卢比可看似极为骄傲，但外强中干，当遭遇眼下巨变后，怯懦的性子一览无遗。
站在陆宁巨大身躯之旁，卢比可更是吓得簌簌发抖。
“怎么，怕我将他扔海里去么？”陆宁突然笑着问。
却是安嘉再一次端着茶盘从舱中走出来，茶盘里有一些水果茶点。
她来来回回几次了，陆宁每次都说不用，但她却乐此不疲，自然是担心儿子受到伤害。
“啊，不是，殿下怎么会和一小小孩童生气？……”
登上这令人眼花缭乱的强大战船，安嘉等才知道，原来齐人神使，便是传说中的黑海亲王，令人也不知道是喜是忧。
毕竟，成为东方强大帝国皇族的战俘，总比落在原本看作巨魔似的异类手里幸运许多。
而现今，黑海亲王登上这艘有着能发出可怕火球的恐怖战船，前去征格但斯克。
从后海海域到格但斯克港，甚至不用半日。
格但斯克，波美拉尼亚人最大聚落、海港，也是安嘉曾经温馨无比的家，还记得，城里伯爵官邸的花花草草，以及和丈夫、儿子，在官邸里温馨的一幕幕。
可是，原本留守格但斯克的小弗朗齐歇克，也就是丈夫的弟弟，在特旺斯特堡陷落后，却是暴露了他的极大野心，收到齐人索要赎金的书信，他不但拒不接受，还回了一封辱骂齐人的信笺，如果齐人是蛮子，怕早就被激怒，将所有战俘的脑袋砍下送去格但斯克了。
是以，黑海亲王征格但斯克，安嘉心里怪怪的，既不想故乡被齐人征服蹂躏，可是，又很想看看那背叛了丈夫的小叔子，被齐人抓住的狼狈一幕。
而黑海亲王在这艘船里带上了她的儿子卢比可，她本就担心。
刚刚黑海亲王召了卢比可来这船楼最上层甲板，更令她有些骇怕，是以，才频频借口送来茶点探看动静，万一卢比可说错了话，她也好圆场。
此时被黑海亲王说破心事，安嘉心里更升起阴霾。
此时，却见黑海亲王微微一笑，说：“有封信笺你看看，需要你最后签上你的名字。”说着话从袖子里摸出一页纸笺递给她。

安嘉接过一看，立时呆住，这却是用她口吻写的一封信，正告小弗朗齐歇克不要做任何抵抗，见信后立即投降。
信里说，大齐黑海亲王看重卢比可的才干，已经收他为义子，并认为他可以为波美拉尼亚带来永久的繁荣和和平，是以，将会封卢比可为波美拉尼亚公爵，每年只需向黑海亲王缴纳一个银元的赋税。
安嘉怎么都想不到，突然有这样峰回路转一幕，一时怔住。
对波美拉尼亚人如何安置陆宁经过了一番思量，最终决定，还是用公国的形势附庸自己为好。
毕竟，波美拉尼亚人现今出于分裂状态，在后海的波美拉尼亚人，一直奴役的话没什么意义，毕竟自己不想往这里移民，主要还是令本地居民受大齐文明影响亲近大齐。
后海镇，还是多转化普鲁士人成为后海之民。
波美拉尼亚地，如果自己不趁现今良机将大齐的影响力扩展过去，未免浪费了大好机会。
波美拉尼地，可是有十余万人口，如果转化为依附大齐的公国，运筹得当的话，波美拉尼人，以后也就不会是波兰人，而是传承东方文明的一个新的民族，以后便是允许其独立，也当是和大齐友好的东欧小国。
当然，这一切，还是要看后世子孙的运营，但自己打好了基础，以后他们做不好，那也没办法。
就现今来说，如果能将波美拉尼人收拢，那么，以格但斯克港为中心的波美拉尼亚公国，到后海地，到新海市，再到拉脱维亚的里加港、万安湖城，便形成了大齐影响力的一条长链，也是大齐在东欧、北欧商路的核心之地，甚至这条商路，更可以向西延伸，大齐商人可以直接和西欧的北海沿岸进行贸易。
当然，波美拉尼人如果执意心怀仇恨，那么这片地域，将来便可能真的要换了新主人，对大齐的利益也没什么影响。
而收拢波美拉尼人，切好有这卢比可在，其叔叔又谋叛，帮其平叛后再顺理成章扶持他为这个新公国的公爵。
卢比可懦弱又没什么才干，但自然是做傀儡的最佳人选。
倒是几十年后他的接班人，能力如何却无所谓了，当然，最好其接班人精明强干，那时候波美拉尼人应该已经接受齐教亲近齐人，接班人比较优秀才是好事，反而知道这半独立的公国对其最是有利，如果昏庸无能，使得公国经常爆发矛盾甚至内战，还需要齐人来擦屁股。
对欧洲蛮子来说，并不是每个族群的首领都想成为国王，成为强大帝国的封臣不是什么坏事，毕竟实际在他自己的领地，他就是国王，尤其是，黑海亲王仅仅需要每年一银元赋税，又去哪里找这样仁慈的君王？
不过此刻，看着卢比可，陆宁摇摇头，叹息道：“只是，他这个样子，真能成为一位成功的大领主吗？”
安嘉这时惊醒回神，立时急急道：“他可以的，他一定会努力的。”又赶忙走过去拉儿子衣袖，“快，给殿下磕头见礼，殿下喜爱你要收你为养子，你还不知道怎么做吗？”
卢比可听得眼睛一亮，马上屈膝跪倒，用齐人隆重礼仪稽首，“父亲大人，儿一定不辜负父亲大人的见爱！”显然，突然闻听竟然能成为这位尊贵又强大的东方皇族亲王之养子，他惊喜不已。
安嘉心中本欣喜若狂，可看着这一幕，又莫名心酸。
陆宁看着他笑笑，“好，你下去吧。”

卢比可忙又磕头，然后起身，忙不迭去下层甲板，他和士卒们住在一起。
陆宁看着远方碧海，淡淡道：“你签字吧，到了格但斯克，便叫人将书信送进城去。”
“是……”安嘉答应着，心中却患得患失。
content_en:
The Hedong sailed slowly along the clearly visible outline of the land in the distance, with four Swedish warships following closely on both sides.
The sun was shining brightly and the scenery of the blue sea was stunning.
On the deck of the ship, Lu Ning stood in front of the railing. Beside him, stood a pale blond boy with trembling fear. The freckles on his face had not faded away. He was the only son of Count Franciszek and Mrs. Anjia - Rubik.
There is no doubt that Count Franzišek and his wife are the best among the Polish nobility, if not the best among them. However, they obviously dote on their son, making Rubik seem extremely proud, but strong on the outside and capable in the inside. When faced with the current great changes, his cowardly temperament is clearly visible.
Standing next to Lu Ning's huge body, Ruby was even more frightened and trembling.
"What, are you afraid that I will throw him into the sea?" Lu Ning suddenly asked with a smile.
But Anjia once again walked out of the cabin with a tea tray containing some fruit refreshments.
She went back and forth several times, and Lu Ning said no every time, but she never tired of it, because she was naturally worried that her son would be harmed.
"Ah, no, why would His Highness be angry with a child?..."
After boarding this dazzling and powerful warship, Anjia and others found out that the envoy of Qi Ren was the legendary Prince of the Black Sea, which made people wonder whether they were happy or sad.
After all, it is much luckier to become a prisoner of war of the powerful imperial family of the East than to fall into the hands of aliens who were originally regarded as trolls.
Now, the Prince of the Black Sea boarded this terrifying warship that could emit terrifying fireballs, and went to conquer Gdansk.
It doesn't even take half a day to get from Houhai to the port of Gdańsk.
Gdańsk, the largest Pomeranian settlement and seaport, was also Anjia’s warm home. I still remember the flowers and plants in the Earl’s mansion in the city, as well as the warm scenes with her husband and son in the mansion.
However, the young Franzischek, who was originally staying in Gdansk, his husband's brother, exposed his great ambition after the fall of Twänstborg. When he received a letter from the Qi people asking for ransom, he not only refused to accept it, but also replied with a letter insulting the Qi people. If the Qi people were barbarians, they would have been angered long ago and cut off the heads of all the prisoners of war and sent them to Gdansk.
Therefore, when the Prince of the Black Sea conquered Gdansk, Anjia felt strange in her heart. She did not want her hometown to be conquered and ravaged by the Qi people, but she also wanted to see the embarrassing scene of her brother-in-law who had betrayed her husband and was caught by the Qi people.
The Prince of the Black Sea brought her son Rubik in this ship, and she was already worried.
The Prince of the Black Sea had just summoned Rubik to come to the top deck of the ship, which made her even more frightened. Therefore, she repeatedly made excuses to bring refreshments to see what was going on, so that if Rubik said something wrong, she could smooth things over.
At this time, the prince of the Black Sea revealed his feelings, and Anjia felt even more gloomy.
At this time, the Prince of Black Sea smiled slightly and said, "There is a piece of paper for you to look at. I need you to sign your name at the end." As he spoke, he took out a page of paper from his sleeve and handed it to her.
Anjia took it and looked at it, and was immediately stunned. This was a letter written in her own voice, telling little Franzishek not to make any resistance and to surrender immediately after seeing the letter.
The letter said that the Prince of Daqi and the Black Sea valued Rubik's talents and had adopted him as his adopted son, and believed that he could bring permanent prosperity and peace to Pomerania. Therefore, Rubik would be made Duke of Pomerania and he would only have to pay a tax of one silver dollar to the Prince of the Black Sea every year.
An Jia never expected that such a twist and turn would occur suddenly, and she was stunned for a moment.
After some thought about how the Pomeranians would settle Lu Ning, they finally decided that it would be better to use the situation of the principality to vassalize themselves.
After all, the Pomeranians are currently in a state of division. It makes no sense to keep the Pomeranians in Houhai enslaved. After all, I don’t want to immigrate here. The main thing is to make the local residents suffer from the Qi civilization.The influence is close to Daqi.
Houhai Town still transformed many Prussians into Houhai people.
In Pomerania, if you don't take advantage of the current opportunity to expand Daqi's influence there, you will be wasting a great opportunity.
The Pomeranian land has a population of more than 100,000. If it is transformed into a principality dependent on Daqi, and if everything is planned properly, the Pomeranians will no longer be Poles, but a new nation inheriting Eastern civilization. In the future, they will be allowed to be independent, and they will be regarded as a small Eastern European country that is friendly to Daqi.
Of course, all this still depends on the operations of future generations, but if you have laid the foundation yourself, there is nothing you can do if they don't do well in the future.
For now, if the Pomeranians can be gathered together, then the Principality of Pomerania with the Port of Gdansk as the center, to Houhai, to Xinhai City, to the Port of Riga and Wan'an Lake City in Latvia, will form a long chain of Daqi's influence. It will also be the core of Daqi's trade routes in Eastern and Northern Europe. This trade route can even be extended to the west, and Daqi merchants can trade directly with the North Sea coast of Western Europe.
Of course, if the Pomeranians insist on harboring hatred, then this area may really have a new owner in the future, which will have no impact on Daqi's interests.
And to win over the Pomeranians, it is best to have this rupee. His uncle plotted a rebellion again. After helping him put down the rebellion, it was logical to support him as the Duke of this new principality.
Ruby is cowardly and has no talent, but she is naturally the best candidate to be a puppet.
However, it does not matter how capable his successor will be decades later. Of course, it is best if his successor is smart and capable. By that time, the Pomeranians should have accepted the Qi religion and be close to the Qi people. It is a good thing for the successor to be better. Instead, they know that this semi-independent principality is the most beneficial to them. If they are incompetent, conflicts or even civil wars often break out in the principality, and Qi people will be needed to wipe the butt.
For European barbarians, not every leader of the ethnic group wants to be a king. Becoming a vassal of a powerful empire is not a bad thing. After all, in his own territory, he is actually the king. Especially, the Prince of the Black Sea only needs one silver dollar in tax every year, so where can he find such a benevolent king?
But at this moment, looking at Lubico, Lu Ning shook his head and sighed: "But, can he really become a successful lord like this?"
An Jia woke up at this moment and said urgently: "He can do it, he will definitely work hard." Then he hurriedly walked over and pulled his son's sleeves, "Quick, kowtow to His Highness. His Highness loves you and wants to adopt you as his adopted son. Don't you know what to do?"
Lubico's eyes lit up when he heard this, and he immediately knelt down and bowed his head with a solemn etiquette, "Father, my son will definitely live up to your father's love!" Obviously, he was pleasantly surprised to suddenly hear that he could become the adopted son of this noble and powerful prince of the Eastern royal family.
An Jia was ecstatic in her heart, but looking at this scene, she felt inexplicably sad.
Lu Ning looked at him and smiled, "Okay, go down."
Ruby kowtowed hurriedly, then got up and hurriedly went to the lower deck, where he lived with the soldiers.
Lu Ning looked at the blue sea in the distance and said calmly: "You sign, and when we get to Gdańsk, we will have someone deliver the letter to the city."
"Yes..." Anjia agreed, but she was worried about gains and losses.
